models.name: hrm_platform_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest accounts identified by device fingerprint for anonymous platform access.

Guests are unauthenticated users who access the platform without creating a member account. Each guest is uniquely identified by a device fingerprint, allowing the system to recognize returning guests and maintain their session context. Guest accounts are temporary and do not have email/password credentials.

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description: Unique device identifier for guest recognition.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was soft deleted.

models.name: hrm_platform_guest_sessions
models.description: Temporary session tokens for guest access with expiration tracking. Stores JWT session data including access and refresh tokens for anonymous platform access.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address at session creation.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current page URL when session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for automatic invalidation.

models.name: hrm_platform_members
models.description: Registered member accounts with email/password credentials and global profile information. Members can belong to multiple organizations and switch between them. Profile information (display name, avatar, phone) is shared across all organizations.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for authentication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's display name shown across all organizations.

plainFields.name: avatar_image
plainFields.description: URL to user's avatar/profile image.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: User's phone number for contact.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last profile update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for account deletion.

models.name: hrm_platform_member_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens with access and refresh token support for member authentication. Tracks active login sessions with expiration, device information, and token hashes for validation. Each session belongs to exactly one member and is created during login, expired during logout or timeout.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address at session creation for security auditing.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Original URL where login was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header at login time.

plainFields.name: access_token_hash
plainFields.description: Hash of the current access token for validation and revocation.

plainFields.name: refresh_token_hash
plainFields.description: Hash of the current refresh token for validation and revocation.

plainFields.name: device_info
plainFields.description: Client device information (user agent, browser, OS) for session identification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. Sessions are invalid after this time.

models.name: hrm_platform_member_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens with expiration for member account recovery. Stores temporary tokens generated when members request password reset, with expiration tracking and usage state. Each token belongs to exactly one member and can be used only once.

foreignFields.name: hrm_platform_member_id
foreignFields.description: Target's {@link hrm_platform_members.id}. Member account requesting password reset.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token sent to member's email.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Token becomes invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was consumed. Null if not yet used.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if record is active.

models.name: hrm_platform_member_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for member registration validation. Stores temporary tokens sent to users during signup to verify email ownership. Each token has an expiration time and is consumed upon successful verification. Members can request new tokens if previous ones expire.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Verification token sent to user's email for validation.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp after which verification is invalid.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for record removal.

models.name: hrm_platform_organizations
models.description: Core multi-tenancy entity representing independent organizational workspaces. Each organization owns its employees, departments, projects, and all business data. Contains organization settings including name, description, logo image, currency, timezone, and fiscal year start month configuration.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Organization name for display and identification.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the organization's purpose or business.

plainFields.name: logo
plainFields.description: URL to the organization's logo image.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, KRW) for financial displays.

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g., America/New_York, Asia/Seoul) for date/time displays.

plainFields.name: fiscal_start_month
plainFields.description: Fiscal year start month (1-12) for financial reporting periods.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was soft deleted (null if active).

models.name: hrm_platform_departments
models.description: Organizational departments providing structural hierarchy within an organization. Each department has a name, optional description, and optional parent department for one-level nesting. Departments enable employee categorization and organizational reporting. All departments belong to exactly one {@link hrm_platform_organizations} for data isolation.

foreignFields.name: parent_department_id
foreignFields.description: Parent department's {@link hrm_platform_departments.id} for one-level hierarchy. Null for top-level departments.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Department name for identification and display.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional department description explaining purpose or scope.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when department was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when department was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when department was soft deleted. Null for active departments.

models.name: hrm_platform_employees
models.description:
Organizational membership records linking users to organizations with role, department, position, employment type, and status.

Each record represents a user's membership in a specific organization. A user can have multiple employee records across different organizations. Each employee has exactly one role, optional department assignment, position title, employment type classification, and activation status.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Job title or position within the organization.

plainFields.name: employment_type
plainFields.description: Employment classification: full-time, part-time, contractor, intern.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Employee status: active or deactivated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp.

models.name: hrm_platform_employee_contracts
models.description: Historical employment agreements documenting compensation and work terms for employees. Each employee can have multiple contracts over time with only one active at a time. References {@link hrm_platform_employees}. Immutable records preserve employment history.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Contract effective start date.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Contract end date. Null indicates ongoing contract.

plainFields.name: pay_rate
plainFields.description: Compensation rate per pay period unit.

plainFields.name: pay_period
plainFields.description: Payment frequency: hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly.

plainFields.name: working_hours_per_week
plainFields.description: Expected weekly working hours.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Additional contract terms or comments.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp.

models.name: hrm_platform_roles
models.description:
Organization-scoped permission sets including built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) and custom roles.

Each role belongs to exactly one organization and defines a set of permissions granted to employees assigned to that role. Built-in roles are system-defined and cannot be deleted, while custom roles can be created, edited, and deleted by organization owners (when no employees are assigned).

Roles support many-to-many relationship with permissions through {@link hrm_platform_role_permissions} junction table. Each employee in an organization is assigned exactly one role via {@link hrm_platform_employees.role_id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Role name (e.g., Owner, Manager, Employee, or custom role name).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the role's purpose and responsibilities.

plainFields.name: is_builtin
plainFields.description: True for system-built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) that cannot be deleted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was soft-deleted (null if active).

models.name: hrm_platform_role_permissions
models.description:
Junction table mapping roles to their granted permissions for many-to-many relationship.

Each row represents one permission granted to a specific role. Built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) and custom roles both use this table to define their permission sets. Supports filtering permissions by role and roles by permission.

foreignFields.name: hrm_platform_role_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to {@link hrm_platform_roles.id}. The role that holds this permission.

plainFields.name: permission
plainFields.description: Permission code (e.g., org:manage, employee:manage, employee:view, project:manage, project:view, time:manage, time:approve, time:view_all, report:view).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was soft deleted (null if active).

models.name: hrm_platform_invitations
models.description: Pending employee invitations by email before account creation. Links organizations to invited users, tracking invitation lifecycle from sending through acceptance or expiration. Supports pre-account invitation workflow where users are automatically added to organizations upon signup with invited email.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link hrm_platform_members.id}. Null until user signs up with invited email.

foreignFields.name: invited_by_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link hrm_platform_members.id} who sent this invitation.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Invited email address. Used to match existing users or create account linkage upon signup.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Invitation status: pending, accepted, expired, revoked.

plainFields.name: invited_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when invitation was sent.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when invitation expires and becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: accepted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when invitation was accepted. Null if not yet accepted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Created timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Updated timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Deleted timestamp for soft delete.

models.name: hrm_platform_projects
models.description: Work containers grouping related tasks and timelogs within an organization. Each project has a name, color code for UI display, status (active/archived/completed), optional budget hours, and optional timeline dates. Projects are organization-scoped for multi-tenancy data isolation.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Project name for identification.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional project description detailing purpose and scope.

plainFields.name: color_code
plainFields.description: Hex color code for UI display and visual identification.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Project status: active, archived, or completed.

plainFields.name: budget_hours
plainFields.description: Optional total estimated budget hours for the project.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional project start date.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Optional project end date.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft delete, null if active.

models.name: hrm_platform_project_members
models.description:
Junction table assigning employees to projects with role attribute (member or project-lead), enabling team membership tracking.

Links employees to their assigned projects within an organization. Each membership record specifies the employee's role in the project, distinguishing between regular members and project leads who have task management authority. Prevents duplicate assignments through unique constraint on employee-project pair.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Project role: member or project-lead. Project leads can manage tasks within their project.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project membership was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project membership was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project membership was soft deleted (null if active).

models.name: hrm_platform_tasks
models.description: Work items within projects with title, status, priority, estimated hours, due date, optional assignment to employee, and optional parent task for subtask hierarchy.

foreignFields.name: parent_task_id
foreignFields.description: Parent task's {@link hrm_platform_tasks.id} for subtask hierarchy.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Task description.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Task status: open, in-progress, completed, closed.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Task priority: low, medium, high, urgent.

plainFields.name: estimated_hours
plainFields.description: Estimated hours to complete the task.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Task due date.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp.

models.name: hrm_platform_task_histories
models.description: Audit trail entries capturing task status transitions with timestamp, old status, new status, and the user who made the change. Each entry records a single status change event for tracking task progression and accountability. References {@link hrm_platform_tasks} for the task being tracked and {@link hrm_platform_members} for the actor who made the change.

plainFields.name: old_status
plainFields.description: Previous task status before the transition (e.g., open, in-progress, completed, closed).

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: New task status after the transition (e.g., open, in-progress, completed, closed).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the status change was recorded.

models.name: hrm_platform_timelogs
models.description: Individual time entry records capturing work sessions with date, duration, project, optional task, description, and billable flag. Each timelog belongs to exactly one employee and one project, optionally references a task within that project. Timelogs can be grouped into timesheets for approval workflow - when included in an approved timesheet, the timelog becomes locked (immutable).

foreignFields.name: employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who logged the time. {@link hrm_platform_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: project_id
foreignFields.description: Project the time was logged against. {@link hrm_platform_projects.id}.

foreignFields.name: task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional task within the project. {@link hrm_platform_tasks.id}.

foreignFields.name: timesheet_id
foreignFields.description: Timesheet this timelog belongs to, null if not yet submitted. {@link hrm_platform_timesheets.id}.

plainFields.name: date
plainFields.description: Date the work was performed (date only, time component ignored).

plainFields.name: duration_minutes
plainFields.description: Duration of work session in minutes.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of what work was done.

plainFields.name: billable
plainFields.description: Whether this time is billable to client (default true).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timelog was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timelog was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timelog was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: hrm_platform_timesheets
models.description:
Weekly collections of timelogs with approval workflow status (draft, submitted, approved, rejected) and review metadata.

Timesheets group an employee's timelogs by week (Monday to Sunday) for approval tracking. Employees create draft timesheets, submit them for approval, and users with time:approve permission can approve or reject them. Approved timesheets lock all included timelogs from editing or deletion.

foreignFields.name: employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who owns this timesheet. {@link hrm_platform_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: reviewed_by_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who approved or rejected this timesheet. {@link hrm_platform_employees.id}.

plainFields.name: week_start_date
plainFields.description: Monday of the timesheet week (ISO date format YYYY-MM-DD).

plainFields.name: week_end_date
plainFields.description: Sunday of the timesheet week (ISO date format YYYY-MM-DD).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Timesheet workflow status: draft, submitted, approved, rejected.

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when timesheet was submitted for approval.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when timesheet was approved or rejected.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided when timesheet was rejected (required for rejected status).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timesheet was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timesheet was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timesheet was soft deleted.

models.name: hrm_platform_timers
models.description:
Active timer state for real-time time tracking.

Each employee can have at most one running timer at a time. Timers record the start timestamp, associated project, optional task, and work description. When stopped, timers convert to timelog entries with calculated duration. Timers continue running indefinitely until explicitly stopped or discarded by the employee.

foreignFields.name: employee_id
foreignFields.description: The employee who owns this timer. {@link hrm_platform_employees.id}.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer was started.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the work being tracked.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for record archival.

models.name: hrm_platform_activity_logs
models.description: Immutable audit trail of significant organizational actions including employee lifecycle events, contract changes, project actions, task status changes, timesheet workflow, and role assignments. Each entry captures the actor (member), action type, target entity reference, and metadata. Append-only records support compliance auditing and debugging across all organizational domains.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization's {@link hrm_platform_organizations.id}. Required for data isolation.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link hrm_platform_members.id}. The user who performed the action.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Action classification (e.g., employee.invited, employee.deactivated, contract.created, project.archived, task.status_changed, timesheet.submitted, role.assigned).

plainFields.name: target_entity_type
plainFields.description: Entity type affected by the action (e.g., employee, contract, project, task, timesheet, role).

plainFields.name: target_entity_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the affected entity if applicable. Null for actions without specific entity target.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Structured metadata about the action in JSON format. Contains action-specific details like old/new values, reasons, or context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the activity log was created (when the action occurred).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the activity log was last updated. Static for append-only audit logs.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft delete. Null means active record.
